en-US.title: Hebigat Radio
en-US.subtitle: 100% Lossless Hi-Fi Stream
en-US.description:
Hebigat Radio is The Philippines' First & Only Lossless Stream — broadcasting 100% lossless Hi-Fi audio (90s Alternative, Rock, Pop, New Wave, and Dance) live from radio.didaskitchen.com.

- Automatically connects to Hebigat Radio (https://radio.didaskitchen.com)
- Bit-perfect lossless FLAC and MP3 streaming
- DLNA / UPnP lossless FLAC casting and Google Cast support
- Live now-playing with cover art, synced lyrics, and running timeline
- The booth: read what the DJ is saying on the mic
- Weekly show schedule and song requests
- Background audio with lock-screen and headphone controls
